name: Express Freight Finance
summary: Carrier factoring with 1 to 12 month contracts, free credit checks and no reserve.
differentiator: States contract options from 1 to 12 months, among the shortest offered, plus no volume or concentration limits, so one big broker can be most of your freight. It writes that a flat rate "should generally be no higher than 3%" but does not publish its own.

terms.recourse: Covers the risk if your customer cannot pay due to insolvency or bankruptcy
terms.contract: Flexible 1-12 month contracts, optional DropPay upgrade
terms.otherFees: Free credit checks, no setup fees, no reserve requirements
terms.fuel: Same-day fuel advances on booked loads
